gaps.claim: MAX_TRADING = 25 is below what the platform runs (34 paper bots trading at 06:16 UTC), so resume_wave's free slots are 0 and every non-discarded bot is skipped as 'no free slot'.

resume_wave never asks clone.restart_refusal before stopping old rooms and opening a new proposal and room; a bot with an older their_guard/unexplained stop is refused inside clone.enable, counted transient, and gets a new room on every run.

A their_trigger stop is labelled stop-loss/take-profit from the sign of the bot's cumulative profit, not from the recorded auto_pause_reason; a bot in profit that hits its stop-loss reads 'take-profit'.

restart_refusal recomputes bot_stops over all samples plus trigger_stops_now (bot_stops again, last_accepted_start per instance over all clone rows) for every instance; bot_variants calls it per bot each tick.
gaps.note: all three: true but harmless, 7-16 ms a call, under a second a tick

gaps.claim: select_items refuses any finding holding an accepted report whatever its filing state; a WITHDRAWN row's genuine recurrence can be neither filed nor reopened (reopen exists only for FIX_CLAIMED).
gaps.note: WITHDRAWN is terminal by design; the only such row is #53, the closed wallet item

gaps.claim: bot_runs duplicates bot_stops' stop classification without carrying the reason; the two copies have already drifted.
The free-slot count takes each instance's latest sample ever, so a released clone whose last reading said is_trading holds a slot for ever.
_mark_repins runs before _apply_events and before the run is applied to rows the journal creates (splits), so their repinned mark lags a fold.
gaps.note: t3: the lag is _apply_check_definition skipping a pin on a row a split has not created yet (fold.py:418-420); moving _mark_repins fixes nothing; the one real split was pinned 31 min later

Code exempts a bot once its leaderboard row says synthetic and never asks the page; it passed (VERIFIED FIXED, #175) while /backtest still says 'against historical data' and nowhere 'synthetic' (lines 18-19 vs 108-111; run 20261007T205757Z page_mentions_synthetic false).
